column_description: Unique identifier for each stringency measure entry.
Reference to the country. may be NULL.
Date for which the stringency index is recorded. may be NULL.
Index representing the stringency of public health measures. may be NULL.
Status of lockdown (e.g., partial, full). always exactly one of 'partial', 'full'. may be NULL.
Status of travel restrictions (e.g., domestic, international). always exactly one of 'domestic', 'international'. may be NULL.
Status of school closures (e.g., open, closed). always exactly one of 'open', 'closed'. may be NULL.
Status of public events (e.g., allowed, restricted). always exactly one of 'allowed', 'restricted'. may be NULL.
Status of workplace closures (e.g., essential only, closed). always exactly one of 'essential only', 'closed'. may be NULL.
Status of public transport (e.g., reduced, normal). always exactly one of 'reduced', 'normal'. may be NULL.
Status of stay-at-home requirements (e.g., recommended, mandated). always exactly one of 'recommended', 'mandated'. may be NULL.
Status of information campaigns (e.g., active, inactive). always exactly one of 'active', 'inactive'. may be NULL.
